items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the other band that I’ve had since ’91, with Vic Juris, Tony Marino, Jamey Haddad for 10 years... that band’s still going with Tony and Vic and Marco now

ctx.x: Look, I’ve had a band for 20 years now. I would love to able to have enough work to say, “I’d like you to come in one night on bass” or somebody else to come in, besides Vic, or with Vic, let’s say, just using him. If I had six weeks in a row, I could do that. But if I have like six days a year, I can’t do that. That’s a side effect of not having work that we don’t think about, that you can’t – the relay system. You don’t have anything to relay, because you don’t have time to do it. I think musically that’s not…
The whole idea of working clubs.
